questions.q: Find the coefficient of x^11 in the expansion of (x^3 - 2/x^2)^12.
questions.explanation: The general term is 12Cr * (-1)^r * 2^r * x^(36-5r). Set 36-5r=11, giving r=5. Hence the coefficient is 12C5*(-1)^5*2^5 = -25344.

questions.q: Does the expansion of (x^2 - 2/x)^18 contain a term in x^10?
options: A) Yes, it is the 9th term
B) No, because the required r is not an integer
C) Yes, it is the 10th term
D) No, because all powers are negative
questions.answer: B) No, because the required r is not an integer
questions.explanation: The general power of x is 36-3r. Requiring x^10 gives 36-3r=10, so r=26/3. Since r must be an integer index in the binomial expansion, no x^10 term occurs.

questions.q: What is the middle term in the expansion of (2ax - b/x^2)^12?
questions.explanation: Since the exponent 12 is even, there are 13 terms and the 7th term is the unique middle term. Substituting r=6 in the general term gives 12C6*(2ax)^6*(-b/x^2)^6. This simplifies to 59136a^6b^6/x^6.

questions.q: If the coefficients of x^7 and x^8 in (2 + x/3)^n are equal, what is n?
questions.explanation: Equate the coefficients nC7*2^(n-7)/3^7 and nC8*2^(n-8)/3^8. Simplifying the ratio of successive binomial coefficients gives 8/(n-7)=1/6. Therefore n=55.
